title: The Survey
author: Hallam Knight
tagline: A dead ship. A hidden signal. A world worth fighting for.
blurb:
When a Drift prospecting crew discovers a derelict ship drifting in impossible space, the TSV Meridian is called to investigate. What they find on board raises more questions than answers: a dead crew, a silent drive and a pulsar that shouldn't exist.

The trail leads to Ross 128 b, where a joint survey between the TSA and the Drift quickly turns from exploration to confrontation. As rival interests close in and the first shots are fired, the crew uncover evidence of an ancient presence: a set of coordinates that point to a star no catalogue has ever seen.

With the help of new allies, a hidden fellowship and a translation that rewrites what humanity thought it knew, a new destination emerges: Elyndra.

But answers come at a cost, old alliances are tested, and some truths may be too dangerous to share.
